pages.title: Stomp Rocket Dueling Rockets
pages.description: Stomp Rocket Dueling Rockets launches two foam rockets at once for head-to-head races. No batteries needed - just stomp to launch. Ages 5+.
pages.ld_description:
Stomp Rocket Dueling Rockets


Designed for children ages 5 and up, perfect for energetic outdoor fun and family playtime.


Launches two high-flying foam rockets simultaneously, creating thrilling head-to-head duels for kids and friends. 🚀


Includes a durable launch pad, air hose, and 4 foam-tipped rockets built for repeated use.


Powered 100% by kids — simply run, jump, and stomp to blast rockets sky-high, no batteries needed.


Encourages outdoor play, active movement, coordination, and friendly competition while keeping kids engaged.


Helps introduce basic STEM concepts such as force and trajectory in a fun, hands-on way.


Quick to set up, lightweight, and portable — perfect for backyards, parks, and family gatherings.


Turn any outdoor space into a lively rocket arena! With exciting duels, heart-racing action, and endless play potential, Stomp Rocket Dueling Rockets keeps kids active and learning while having a blast. 🌟
